# Rook anatomical graphical data

Rook uses the unchanged CC0 MakeHuman/MPFB graphical base mesh, metadata and numeric morph-target data pinned to upstream commit `d0a32e57a7f915cb2f2b95410e2117648c7bbb7e`. `MANIFEST.json` references the already vendored files in place, with exact upstream paths, immutable URLs, byte sizes, SHA-256 and Git blob SHA-1 values. No additional binary assets are downloaded or duplicated.

The graphical-data license is `third_party/mpfb_assets/LICENSE.ASSETS.md` (CC0-1.0), with the upstream license split documented in the adjacent `LICENSE.md` and shared README. No GPL addon program logic is imported, installed or executed. The importer, static rest deformation, topology-preserving reduction and integration are Fury code. Commercial reference photographs remain private study material and do not enter source assets or generated headers.

`rook_recipe.json` is an original combination selected for a compact broad chin/jaw, distinct cheeks and projecting nose, modest hooded upper fold, broader mouth and substantial neck. Numeric source filenames are morph controls, not assertions of a character's age, ethnicity, gender or biography. The production identity remains CrewRook, Rook, 1.70 m, CrewTech, network Muscle. The deterministic original skin/hair/clothing palette is unchanged.

`build_rook_anatomy.py` reconstructs every retained head/neck source vertex, triangle, winding and source UV corner. `build_rook_hands.py` extracts the connected source hand with a twenty-edge wrist boundary, applies the documented monotonic static rest curl and preserves every Near triangle. The original endpoint-quadric Far reduction locks the wrist, applies the manifold link condition and rejects triangle reversals. Rendering normal splits retain the original positions and topology at concave nail/finger folds. Hand orientation is a rigid fit in `character_rook.cpp`; fingers are not independently animated.

The generated `rook_anatomy.hpp` and `rook_hands.hpp` are reproducible with the two build scripts. `tests/rook_anatomy_source_tests.py` independently reads the pinned OBJ and target bytes without importing either producer, reconstructs all source coordinates/corners and verifies both hand topologies with deliberate corrupt-output controls. Character-level tests separately check registration, exact palette, rig, source integration, actual mesh seams, posed geometry, wardrobe support and production renderers.
